strings: r_c0 notices m_c leaning against a tree trunk. m_c says that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} feeling dizzy.
m_c stood up too fast and got dizzy.
m_c staggers when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/try/tries} to stand up.
The world tilts around m_c when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stand/stands} up.
m_c feels cold and dizzy when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stand/stands} up.
m_c hisses when a Clanmate says that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} should just be more careful when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stand/stands} up.
